# Donny Michel

> Creative director and commercial photographer based in San Diego, California. 13+ years leading brand creative across photography, video, graphic design, web design and app development. Seeking a full-time creative director role (photographer roles welcome) in San Diego, on-site or hybrid, or fully remote.

## At a glance
- Role sought: Full-time creative director. Senior photography and brand creative roles welcome too.
- Location: San Diego, California. On-site, hybrid or fully remote.
- Experience: 13+ years across creative direction, brand, photography and video.
- Strengths: Creative direction, brand strategy, content and campaigns, team and vendor leadership, AI-powered creative workflows.
- Education: Bachelor of Business Administration in Marketing, American InterContinental University.
- Contact: https://www.linkedin.com/in/donnymichel

## Current
- Donny Michel Photography (2013–now): Commercial Photographer & Videographer. Brand, food, product, portrait, headshot and e-commerce photography. https://donnymichelphotography.com/
- Island Stone & Tile (2026–now): Brand Manager. Brought AI into the marketing team's daily workflow and built in-house web applications, including a dealer portal, a material estimator and a tile pattern tool.

## Previously
- Mor Furniture for Less (2025–26): Senior Photographer & Studio Manager. Concepted, storyboarded, scripted, filmed and edited TV commercials that ran on broadcast TV, YouTube and social.
- Walking & Talking (2023–25): Director of Content. Lean, run-and-gun video content that reached 1M+ views across platforms; Shopify storefront and packaging design.
- Seacoast Multimedia (2020–23): Litigation Support Specialist.
- San Diego Print House (2015–19): Founder. Grew it from startup to 350+ partners and a successful exit.
